test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In ΔABC, DE ∥ AC, where D and E are the points on sides AB and BC, respectively. If BD = 2 cm and AD = 19 cm, then what is the ratio of the area of ΔBDE to the trapezium ADEC?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sides of **ΔBDE** and **ΔBAC** = BD : BA = 2 : (2 + 19) = 2 : 21.

Since **DE || AC**, the ratio of their areas = (Ratio of sides)² = (2/21)² = 4 : 441.

Area of **trapezium ADEC** = Area(ΔBAC) − Area(ΔBDE) = 441 − 4 = 437.

Required ratio = Area(ΔBDE) : Area(trapezium ADEC) = 4 : 437.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 437.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **BD = 2 cm**, **AD = 19 cm**, and **DE || AC**.

**Formula Used:** If two triangles are similar, the ratio of their areas is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cce5c9ff875a515f92e391c5e8ea3e748f7ab5e5c916e75289c2104098601a95.png] 

⇒ Total length of side AB = BD + AD = 2 + 19 = 21 cm.

⇒ In **ΔABC**, since **DE || AC**, ∠BDE = ∠BAC and ∠BED = ∠BCA (Corresponding angles).

⇒ **ΔBDE ∼ ΔBAC** by AA similarity criterion.

⇒ Area(ΔBDE) / Area(ΔBAC) = (BD / AB)² = (2 / 21)² = 4 / 441.

⇒ Let Area(ΔBDE) = 4k and Area(ΔBAC) = 441k.

⇒ Area of **trapezium ADEC** = Area(ΔBAC) − Area(ΔBDE) = 441k − 4k = 437k.

⇒ Ratio of Area(ΔBDE) to Area(trapezium ADEC) = 4k : 437k = 4 : 437.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 437.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem)

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, the other two sides are divided in the same ratio: BD/DA = BE/EC.

Area Ratio of Similar Triangles

For any two similar triangles, the ratio of their areas is equal to the square of the ratio of any two corresponding sides, altitudes, medians, or angle bisectors.

Properties of Trapezium

A trapezium is a quadrilateral with at least one pair of parallel sides. The area of a trapezium is given by 1/2 × (sum of parallel sides) × height.</p
